Huang, X., Ng, K.W., Todoschuk, T. and Scott, G. (2025). Biocarbon Suitability Evaluation for Direct Injection in Blast Furnace Ironmaking. steel research international 97 (2026), 2278-2287 (published online 22 October 2025). https://doi.org/10.1002/srin.202500726

Locators are printed page numbers 2278-2287 (PDF page = printed - 2277). Mostly a CanmetENERGY lab study (grindability, bulk density, injection-rig burnout, residue reactivity) of a commercial densified biocarbon. Loaded: one plant-level result - almost 27% GHG reduction per t hot metal at full replacement of PCI coal by biocarbon (heat and mass balance model). _other-values: calorific values, base-case P and alkali loads, coke-rate statement. Not loaded: lab burnout and reactivity results (Figs 4-12 are charts). No replacement ratio is printed (coke rate held constant). Volume year 2026; online 2025 - id keeps 2025. Not the Ng et al. 2012 article UKERC cites; prints none of the UKERC IS-IW12 figures.
